arguments.question: Does NVIDIA’s latest 10-Q or earnings materials quantify customer financing, receivables/credit exposure, or reliance of Data Center demand on externally financed AI-infrastructure projects, such that changes in U.S. monetary/financial conditions can be measured as a revenue or margin transmission channel over 21/63 sessions? Please cite primary evidence.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether the macro policy stance can be connected to NVDA fundamentals rather than only through generic customer-capex and equity-discount-rate channels.
